lineupBonus.text: Deploy 3 Heroes of the same type.
Deploy 3 Heroes of the same type and 2 of another type.
Deploy 4 Heroes of the same type.
Deploy 5 Heroes of the same type.

tips.title: Fill the squad with one faction
tips.body: A squad has 5 heroes. Heroes from the same faction unlock a bonus to HP, ATK and DEF: 3 of one faction gives +5%, 3 plus 2 of another faction +10%, 4 of one faction +15%, and all 5 +20%.

tips.title: Know the counter triangle
tips.body: Warrior beats Assault, Assault beats Tactical, Tactical beats Warrior. When your faction counters theirs, your heroes take 20% less damage from them. The game's battle report tells you whether your lineup counters the enemy or is countered.

tips.title: Tanks in front, damage in back
tips.body: A squad has 2 front-row and 3 back-row slots. Frontline heroes have the HP and DEF to absorb hits, so the game tells you to put them in front. Backline heroes deal the damage from behind. Carter (Support) belongs in the back row.

tips.title: Many SSRs only shine against zombies
tips.body: About half of the SSR heroes have skills that only work against monsters ("damage to monsters", "damage from monsters"). They are great for zombies, rallies and events but weak in PvP. Rachel, Logan and Celeste have boosts that work everywhere.

tips.title: DEF is a shield
tips.body: The game describes DEF as a shield that absorbs most damage until it breaks. DEF buffs (Conan, Dirk) add shield; Katya breaks shields faster; damage-reduction passives (Arnold, Dirk, Vince, Virgilio) keep working after the shield is gone.

tips.title: Physical vs Radiation
tips.body: There are two damage types. Radiation dealers: Monroe, Leah, Yana, Lucian, Silas, Celeste and Carter (plus Conan's and Jack's auto attacks). Everyone else deals Physical damage. Bekka and Virgilio cut Radiation damage; Arnold's Field Support only blocks Physical damage. A front line with both covers you either way.

tips.title: Exclusive weapons are huge
tips.body: A level-30 exclusive weapon adds about 703k HP, 8.4k ATK, 4.2k DEF and 5% damage resistance to its hero. That is more HP than levelling the hero to 150. It also raises skill caps from 30 to 40. Upgrading it gives every hero up to +40k HP, +800 ATK and +200 DEF, so weapon shards help your whole roster.

tips.title: 4★ unlocks a big stat talent
tips.body: At Hero Lv. 31 and 4★ the 4th slot unlocks a permanent talent: UR heroes get Doomsday Judgment (+20% HP, ATK and DEF, +10% skill cooldown speed), SSR heroes get Wasteland Wanderer (+10%), and SR heroes Survival Expert (+5%). Pushing a hero to 4★ is one of the biggest single upgrades.

tips.title: Raise stars before skill books
tips.body: Star level caps skill level: 1★ → Lv. 1, 2★ → 5, 3★ → 10, 4★ → 20, 5★ → 30. Stars also multiply skill damage (for example Monroe's sniper shot: 70% ATK at 0★, 486% at 5★). Books beyond the cap are wasted, so star a hero up first. Going from 0 to 5 stars takes 975 shards.

tips.title: UR heroes start faster
tips.body: UR heroes get about 27–46% more HP, ATK and DEF from levels 1–50. From Lv. 65 every hero gains the same from levelling, and the hero's own base stats make the difference. Troop command rises from 52 at Lv. 1 to 351 at Lv. 150.

tips.title: SR gathering bonus is unverified
tips.body: Client data lists a Soldier Load benefit for Jackson, Jamal and Hank, but its live gathering effect is unverified. Do not choose them for gathering on this basis.
